_meta.decision: Founder decision 2026-10-23: rejects the 13-B "kept safe for variety" principle ("We cannot give a bicycle crunch or a V-up or a Russian twist to a injured user") and approves this per-row table with three edits: Lat Pulldown +shoulder; Chin Up = elbow only ("chinup is elbow"); Push Up = wrist + shoulder. Additions only; existing tags are never removed. Ships live (no flag), as the five v13 tags did on 2026-10-22.
